citation.title: Deep learning-aided topology design of metasurfaces for Rayleigh waves
citation.authors: Cheng Zhao, Chen-Xu Liu, Gui-Lan Yu
citation.venue: Journal of Computational Design and Engineering
citation.version_coded: version-of-record abstract only; full text inaccessible

claim.primary_outcome_paraphrase: A VAE and conditional tandem neural network are proposed to design metasurfaces for target Rayleigh-wave isolation efficiently across soil conditions; the abstract gives no direct classical comparison.
claim.claimed_speedup_basis: No classical runtime comparison or speed-up factor in the accessible abstract.
claim.alternatives: Abstract reports 100 design tests with determination coefficients above 0.99 and demonstrates vibration isolation for Metro-induced waves.

baseline.quality_metric: Determination coefficients (R²); time- and frequency-domain responses (abstract)
baseline.quality_gap: R² values reported as more than 0.99 across 100 tests (abstract)

notes: Publisher page and PDF routes returned access errors; no bot challenge was bypassed. Abstract source: https://academic.oup.com/jcde/article/11/3/56/7649376.
